userStories.title: Create lib/archon-check.mjs with result-object API and tests
userStories.description: As a slash command author, I want a pure `checkArchon()` function that returns a result object so that I can handle all archon preflight outcomes without process.exit
acceptanceCriteria: File `lib/archon-check.mjs` exists and exports a named `checkArchon()` function
Return type is `{ ok: true, version: string } | { ok: false, code: 'enoent' | 'incompatible' | 'other', message: string }`
`INCOMPATIBLE_ARCHON_VERSIONS` constant lives in this module (moved from hooks/install.mjs:24)
No `process.exit()` call anywhere in the module
File `test/archon-check.test.mjs` exists covering: enoent branch, version OK branch, incompatible version branch, generic error branch
Tests use node:test + node:assert/strict pattern matching existing test files
execFileSync is stubbable (injected or mocked) so tests do not require archon on PATH
`pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test` passes
`pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck` passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Extract from hooks/install.mjs:44–67. Replace process.exit(1) with return { ok: false, code: ..., message: ... }. For incompatible version, return { ok: false, code: 'incompatible', message: ... } rather than warn-and-continue (warning becomes the slash command's responsibility). Follow lib/config-loader.mjs discriminated union pattern. Test isolation: pass execFileSync as a parameter or use module mocking via node:test mock.module().

userStories.title: Create lib/install-runner.mjs with runInstall() and tests
userStories.description: As a slash command author, I want a pure `runInstall(projectDir, partialAnswers)` function so that file I/O is separated from user interaction and independently testable
acceptanceCriteria: File `lib/install-runner.mjs` exists and exports a named `runInstall(projectDir, partialAnswers)` function
Return type is `{ ok: true, configPath: string, wroteDocs: boolean, wroteClaudeMd: boolean } | { ok: false, stage: 'validate' | 'config' | 'docs' | 'claude-md', message: string }`
Merge precedence is `defaults < existing < partialAnswers` (matching hooks/install.mjs:145–155 exactly)
Mandatory fields validated after merge: missing `tracker`, `pr_strategy`, or `branching` returns `{ ok: false, stage: 'validate', message: ... }` — no throw, no process.exit
`detectRepoLayout(projectDir)` logic (hooks/install.mjs:73–75) is inlined or re-exported from this module
Function calls `loadConfig`, `getDefaultLabels`, `writeAgentDocs`, `updateAgentSkillsBlock` in the same order as the hook (hooks/install.mjs:128–187)
Function does NOT call `checkArchon()` — that is the slash command's responsibility
Function does NOT prompt — no readline or user-input logic

File `test/install-runner.test.mjs` exists covering: fresh install (all defaults), partial fill (only missing fields updated), full config (no changes), reconfigure (partialAnswers overwrite existing), mandatory-field missing after merge returns validate error
Tests use tmpdir() isolation matching test/setup-explorer.test.mjs:11 pattern
`pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test` passes
`pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck` passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Extract hooks/install.mjs:128–187 into runInstall(). The function signature is runInstall(projectDir: string, partialAnswers: Partial<Config>): RunInstallResult. Move detectRepoLayout from hooks/install.mjs:73–75 to this module. Import loadConfig from lib/config-loader.mjs, getDefaultLabels from lib/labels-config.mjs, writeAgentDocs + updateAgentSkillsBlock from lib/agent-docs-writer.mjs, exploreProject from lib/setup-explorer.mjs. For tests: write a real tmpdir project with a fake CLAUDE.md to satisfy writeAgentDocs/updateAgentSkillsBlock — or pass stubs for the write helpers if using dependency injection.

userStories.title: Create commands/setup.md slash command
userStories.description: As a developer who installed unic-archon-dlc, I want to run `/unic-archon-dlc:setup` so that I can configure the plugin through a conversational interface in Claude Code
acceptanceCriteria: File `commands/setup.md` exists at the plugin root
Command is invocable as `/unic-archon-dlc:setup` (filename matches plugin naming convention)
First line or header references ADR-0001 (`docs/adr/0001-setup-as-slash-command.md`)
Command parses `$ARGUMENTS` for `reconfigure` keyword and free-form intent strings
Command calls `checkArchon()` from `lib/archon-check.mjs` first; on `ok: false` prints the `message` and stops — no partial writes
Command calls `exploreProject()` and `loadConfig()` to discover current config state
Idempotency branches: fresh → ask all three; partial → ask missing only; full + no args → print summary and exit; full + reconfigure → re-prompt all; full + free-form → targeted tweak
Command calls `runInstall(cwd, answers)` from `lib/install-runner.mjs` for all write operations
On success: prints `unic-archon-dlc configured.` plus key/value summary
On `runInstall` failure: prints the staged error message from the result object
Plugin.json `commands` field references `commands/setup.md` (or the commands dir is auto-scanned — verify against plugin.json schema)
userStories.technicalNotes: commands/setup.md is a Claude Code slash command markdown file — it contains the prompt/instructions that Claude executes. It is not a Node.js script. Reference the hybrid idempotency table from the spec. Import path for lib modules: the slash command runs in the Claude Code agent context; it calls the lib modules via JS imports using the plugin root path. Check how other Claude Code plugins wire commands to lib (look at pr-review plugin for command patterns). The `plugin.json` may need a `commands` field added — check current schema against `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
